label: Dubstep / Riddim (Minimal, Triplet, Half-Time)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A long, dark and atmospheric intro of drones and sweeping effects hints at the rhythm, then a riser and a short silence announce the first drop. The drop repeats a hypnotic wobbling motif, a breakdown strips to atmosphere, and the second…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A single mid-bass voice made from FM and wavetable layers, with a square-wave low-frequency oscillator on the filter, plays a short, bouncing one-bar motif with a wet, watery character over a pure mono sine sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Opens with a tense, cinematic hush and a ticking percussion pattern, builds with rising pitch and snare rolls, and lands on a bouncy, relentless drop. The riff mutates every four bars, a short breakdown gives a moment of air, and the…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Short, clipped vocal one-shots, such as hype shouts and single words, are cut into the build-ups as rhythmic punctuation.
cards.palette: A fast, wonky mid-bass riff with sliding pitch and chorus plays tight triplet-feel patterns over the sub, the sound changing slightly every four bars through modulation and filter movement.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM

cards.mood: Heavy and playful, the track starts with a spoken-style call and a short chant over a bare beat, then drops into a bouncing bass groove. The chant returns between phrases as a crowd call-and-response, and a final drop adds a second bass…
cards.vocal: A small group of voices chants in unison with a gruff, shouted timbre; there is no lead singer.
cards.palette: A bouncing, watery mid-bass riff built on a square-wave low-frequency oscillator plays a looping motif over a clean sub, with the chant fitted into the gaps.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM
